The note corrects the earlier answer: the patent was for the "Electrical Indicator of Mechanical Expansion," issued jointly to Vincent Schaefer and Katharine B. Blodgett in 1947. So the blanks fill as: **Vincent J. Schaefer and Katharine B. Blodgett** received a U.S. patent for the **Electrical** Indicator **of Mechanical** Expansion in **1947**.  
CONFIDENCE: 75
